note: AUTHORED input to split.mjs (B-S11, tests zone, D1 pass 5). Every file of the tests zone over R-5's 500 lines becomes a named module of files at or under 500: its test blocks split by title into parts, the declarations two parts read into one shared helper, the rest into the part that reads them. Blocks are named by title prefix, never by line, so the route's earlier edits to these files do not stale the spec. A module is a directory (tests/styles, tests/demo, tests/gates, tests/components and the dock dir are each over 12 files, and a split must not add to them); a file that already sits alone in its own directory splits in place.
